what: Perfil de Tracxn describe a Kichink como marketplace abierto con categorías: fashion, health, beauty, food and drinks, home, pets; comisión de 7.5% por transacción a vendedores.
verbatim_snippet: "Kichink is an online marketplace offering products across categories such as fashion, health, beauty, food and drinks, home, pets etc. It is an open marketplace allowing sellers to open their storefront for free. It charges a commission of 7.5% on the transaction from the sellers."
date: Accedido abril 2026; perfil titulado "2025 Company Profile"
